text:
Juno: Heads up - GammaHealth renewal invoice inv_98453 has extra platform fee line + an HSM add-on we never sold. Link: https://invoices.redwood/gamma/98453
Maya: paste the invoice lines?
Juno: snippet:
```
- platform_fee_monthly: $45,000
- platform_fee_monthly: $45,000
- support_tier: Enterprise
- hsm_integration: $6,500
```
(Their SOW says support: Gold, platform_fee_monthly: $45,000, no HSM)
Suresh: Billing logs show renewal_job_v2 and legacy_sync both created invoices for the same renewal window. Dedup key failed on renewal_date so duplicate PF got through. legacy_sync also merged a flagged add-on from an old profile.
Liam: Sales had a proposed upgrade but CRM shows not accepted. Support should be Gold.
Ava: Customer put payment on hold and asked CS for clarification.
billing-bot: [automated] invoice inv_98453 created by renewal_job_v2 at 2256789001. Duplicate candidate inv_97321. Ticket BLG-4820 opened.
Maya: Action items: remove duplicate PF, remove HSM line, issue credit, regenerate invoice.
Suresh: Adding HSM line investigation to BLG-4820. Root cause: legacy_sync merge bug.
Juno: Estimated credit = $51,500. Auto-credit cap is $25k so need approval.
Maya: @Olivia please advise.
Olivia: Quick check: any evidence customer agreed to HSM or Enterprise support?
Liam: No signed docs; CS notes only feature request.
Ava: Customer chat (attached in CS ticket) shows no acceptance.
Olivia: Approve provisional credit of $51,500 to unblock collection, pending corrected invoice and JE. Finance needs final JE cc'd to me.
Maya: I'll create credit memo and route to accounting.
Suresh: Remediation plan: 1) rollback legacy_sync add-on merge for renewal window; 2) add dedupe key on (customer_id, renewal_cycle_id, renewal_date); 3) run reconciliation for other impacted accounts. ETA 48h.
Juno: I'll notify GammaHealth and confirm timeline.
billing-bot: [automated] credit memo CM-2259 created for $51,500 against inv_98453. BLG-4820 updated.
Ava: I'll send the customer a short corrective notice and timeline.
Maya: Audit note: attach corrected invoice and JE to BLG-4820; escalate if >3 accounts affected.
Olivia: Approved. CC me on final JE.
Suresh: Starting rollback now. Will post status update at 2256792000.
